rules.statement: The court found that the respondent committed an offence of contempt by refusing to give evidence before a Commission, despite having reasonable cause.
rules.supporting_quote: In these circumstances, it cannot be said that he had reasonable cause in refusing to give evidence. In my view therefore, the respondent has committed the offence of contempt as envisaged in section 12 (1) of the Commissions of Inquiry Act (Cap. 393) and this court should take cognizance of such contempt under the provisions of section 12 (3) of the Commissions of Inquiry Act (Cap. 393).
